lines.trans: I asked you over in such a hurry today because we urgently need a professional data report.
It needs to reflect real online sentiment and prove Rong Silun truly suits Princess Qingcheng.
Well now, look at Chief Bu!
Please do not call me that; I am just sitting here for a moment.
You are already sitting behind this desk—you really love this desk, do you not?
And that chair too, where a certain someone's presence has soaked into every grain of wood.
Sister Xiu, what on earth are you talking about?
Stop struggling, Xiaobu; does every chat with me not end up turning into this anyway?
Now I remember—that was my mistake.
Go ahead and tell me what happened.
Mr Chun Yuqiao is ignoring me; I made him angry, and in truth I was the one who hurt him.
Has the relationship between you two already progressed to hurting each other?
